name: Oregon Wildlife Foundation Grant Program
summary: Small cost-reimbursement grants for fish and wildlife habitat restoration, invasive species control and related projects in Oregon, reviewed four times a year, with dollar-for-dollar match.
reporting: A final report with before and after photos or a short video and evidence of public recognition is required, covering progress, successes and challenges, lessons learned and anything else that affected delivery.

steps: Project Committee evaluation and final award determination

eligibility.rule: Capital or endowment campaigns are not proposed
Not a scholarship or fellowship, unless it supports a project the Foundation partners in
Improvement of natural resources is not for private gain
Project does not involve required mitigation or toxic cleanups
Project does not involve wildlife rehabilitation or captive breeding programs
Project does not involve predator control activities

documents: Biologist statement of support for fish, wildlife or habitat-related projects
